style.backgroundSystem: deep cocoa stained wood bed frame dressed with coarse knit textile; matte, straight grain visible, bed rail as the horizon line

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm nursery ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream white #F7F1E6, bean-paste pink #C88A8A, deep cocoa #3A2A24 and one soft blush accent #E6C6C1; warm 4300K low side light at bed height with long soft shadows; deep cocoa stained wood bed dressed with coarse knit textile as the fixed background and surface; one modern rounded sans-serif with Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; icon system is solid deep cocoa #3A2A24 round dots strung on a thin #3A2A24 line; stable product scale, stable gauze layer thickness and drape; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no cool white or blue light
no glossy plastic or velvet props
no change of gauze layer count, quilting pattern or print placement between shots
no brand, store, price, membership badge or QR code in any frame
no size, weight, filling ratio or warmth-grade numerals, no certification marks
no baby sleeping alone, no blanket over mouth or nose, no prone baby
style.presentationRules: identical gauze layer thickness, drape and fold count in every shot; the quilt always rests on a real surface with a visible contact shadow; verticals stay vertical; angles stay in one 3/4-to-overhead family
style.surfaceSystem: deep cocoa stained wood with visible straight grain, plus a coarse knit weave throw for texture contrast
